title: GetConfigurationResponse
description: Response containing the requested configuration entries and any unknown keys. A WriteOnly key MUST NOT appear in configuration[] however the request reached it; the exclusion is a prose rule in 08-configuration.md section 1.3, not something this schema can express, because expressing it would require enumerating key names here and the registry also admits vendor keys. Note that 'readonly' is a boolean and carries no third state for WriteOnly: none is needed, since a WriteOnly key is absent from the response entirely.
